title: Micropsychism makes human minds shadows of discourse

statements.text: A human mind is not an aspect of the consciousness of any micro-level entity, so micropsychism can ground it only by truthmaking. Truthmaking with metaphysical elitism leaves human minds out of the privileged structure of reality, mere shadows cast by the structure of discourse. Since the truth-conditions of claims about consciousness are a priori and do not concern micro-level subjects, micropsychism is false.

sources.quote: They are mere shadows cast by the structure of our discourse
Micropsychism so construed is not a very plausible view.
